scope: Require positive finite paper and drawing units for typed SCALE DXF input and output.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Scale::parseCode assigned group-140 paperUnits and group-141 drawingUnits without domain checks; dxfRW::writeScale emitted both fields without validating them. The DWG SCALE reader already rejects non-finite values but this change does not modify DWG parsing or encoding.

normativeEvidence.relevantRule: Paper units must be positive and non-zero.
Drawing units must be positive and non-zero.

implementationReadiness.change: The DXF parser reads each unit field into a temporary, rejects non-positive or non-finite values before assignment, and preserves the existing typed value on failure. The typed DXF writer refuses invalid units before emitting a record. DWG layout/validation and public callbacks are unchanged.

coverage: The parser accepts positive finite group-140 and group-141 values in both encodings.
The parser rejects zero and negative values without changing the prior unit value in both encodings; ASCII controls also reject NaN and infinity.
Typed ASCII and Binary SCALE writers refuse zero, negative, NaN, and infinite unit values before output.
Valid writer output is parsed back in both encodings and preserves both unit values.
The existing SCALE retained-name owner-budget selector still passes.

limitations: Generated numeric-admission and typed DXF readback only; native annotation display/evaluation was not tested.
DWG annotation-scale object parsing/encoding, group-70 flag semantics, version boundaries, and root dictionary/consumer semantics remain outside this slice.
No support claim is promoted; broader SCALE annotation/version/API qualification remains open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with a source-backed P6 or P5 implementation gap; do not infer native annotation semantics from field transport.
